chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the Zakat al-Fitr, and he said: 'The date is superior.'

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, a title for Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْتَّمْرُ: The date (fruit), identified here as the superior item for the charity
key_terms.صَدَقَةِ الْفِطْرَةِ: Zakat al-Fitr, the obligatory charity given at the end of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What is the best food to give for Zakat al-Fitr according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies dates as the superior (*afdal*) form of Zakat al-Fitr, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of using locally abundant staples. This preference underscores the Shia emphasis on both the spiritual purification of the fasting individual and the practical ease of providing sustenance to the poor, aligning with the Quranic principle of giving from what one loves.
